verdict.rationale: A state business-filing service could plausibly publish APIs and official SDKs, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows no SDK of any kind. All OpenAPI and Swagger probe paths return 404, the bizfile portal sits behind bot management, and the remaining items describe web-portal, mail, in-person and bulk-data channels rather than developer SDKs. Bulk data files and web filing are adjacent channels, not official SDKs, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
